What each side argued

Rider advocate8 claim(s), 6 kept

  1. The waiting period this trip must be measured against is 180 seconds, not 300.

    Read the whole claim

    TRP-02732's platform_policy carries free_wait_sec 180, and the fee schedule's resolution rule reads the figure in force from platform_policy first; the 300-second STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec is retained only to interpret records authored before policy version 2 and is never applied to a record that carries platform_policy, which this one does. The driver therefore had to hold position inside the geofence for a continuous three minutes before the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination at 17:13:20 could be chargeable.

    EV-TRIP-02732 · POL-NS-01

  2. The waiting clock cannot be read off the driver's own arrival tap.

    Read the whole claim

    platform_policy.arrival_marker on this trip is BUTTON, a driver-pressed marker, and POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, expressly not from the arrived event; POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed treatment covers only GPS_AUTO arrivals and says a BUTTON marker is not covered. The 6.7 minutes in trip_record.wait_time_min is simply the difference between that tap and the cancellation, so it is not a measurement of in-geofence dwell and cannot supply the seconds the trace is missing. (The GPS trace cited here is impaired: weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.)

    EV-TRIP-02732, EV-GPS-02732 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-12

  3. Measured on the GPS clock, the effective in-geofence dwell falls 35 seconds short of the minimum.

    Read the whole claim

    The trace's own derived runs show a longest unbroken qualifying run of 145 seconds (17:10:51 to 17:13:16, 15 fixes) and an earlier in-geofence stretch of only 60 seconds (17:06:36 to 17:07:36, 7 fixes), so no continuous 180-second dwell exists, the shortfall is 35 seconds, and POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation fee to be refunded in full regardless of where the rider was. The driver's chat assertion that he 'waited the full time' is not corroborated by any measured run. The trace is impaired — weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE — and I take the shortfall from the trace's own derived numbers rather than presenting impaired evidence as clean.

    EV-GPS-02732 · POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

  4. The 400-second longest_qualifying_run cannot be used to close that shortfall in the driver's favour.

    Read the whole claim

    It runs from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16 and straddles the 195-second sampling hole from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51, during which the trace records no fix at all; those 195 seconds are unmeasured, not waited, which is precisely the situation POL-NS-08(b) treats as a policy-level defect when the gap inside the waiting window exceeds 120 seconds. Read as a continuous dwell the figure asserts the very continuity the trace cannot show, and it counts a hole as presence. (Trace impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.)

    EV-GPS-02732 · POL-NS-08, POL-NS-01

  5. The two in-geofence intervals cannot be added together to manufacture 180 seconds.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-06(i) permits accumulation only where a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and the waiting window, such that holding position was not lawfully possible; EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory covers Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres in this window — so limb (i) is unavailable and the 60-second and 145-second intervals may not be summed, leaving the longest continuous stretch at 145 seconds. I cite the absent advisory for its absence, not for any content it does not have. (The GPS trace is impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.)

    EV-ADVIS-02732-01, EV-GPS-02732 · POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-02732-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

  6. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: all four limbs must hold or the fee is not chargeable at all.

    Read the whole claim

    Three of them are on the record — an arrived event, qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius under POL-NS-02, and a driver termination recorded as RIDER_NO_SHOW — but limb (c) fails, because a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force was not held. A no-show fee cannot be built on the one limb the evidence does not carry, and where a limb fails the refund is fixed by POL-NS-06. (The GPS trace cited is impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.)

    EV-TRIP-02732, EV-GPS-02732 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-06

  7. The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line and nothing else.

    Read the whole claim

    EV-FARE-02732 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole contested SGD 4.50 is still live and falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06; that clause allows no driver compensation where the dwell falls short, so the refund is not netted against any driver payment and no booking or platform fee arises on a trip that never ran.

    EV-FARE-02732 · POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-03

  8. In the alternative, if the Judge concludes that the effective dwell cannot be measured at all, the correct outcome is still not to leave the SGD 4.50 collected.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-08's closing sentence provides that where the only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under its limbs (a) to (d) the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09; the 195-second gap engages limb (b), and the trace's schema weight of 0.39 sits far below the 0.70 confidence floor of POL-NS-09(a). Escalation is terminal and the disputed fee is held rather than collected, so on either route — refund or escalation — the rider does not end up bearing a charge that the driver's own trace cannot support.

    EV-GPS-02732 · POL-NS-08, POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-02Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-02732 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE

Draft 1 - sampled
Rider and driver: this case goes to a human reviewer, and the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is held — not collected and not refunded — until that review is done. I could not decide it on this record, and the reason is a hole in the one piece of evidence that matters. Both sides agree the fee turns on POL-NS-01(c): did the driver hold position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous dwell of at least the 180 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180)? The arrival tap at 17:06:36 is a BUTTON marker, not a platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival, so POL-NS-12 does not apply, and POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the tap. The dwell can therefore only be read from EV-GPS-02732. That trace is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (POL-GEN-02(1)). It carries a 195-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 inside the waiting window, which is a policy-level impairment under POL-NS-08(b). The driver's reading and the rider's reading both depend on that gap, and the trace cannot settle either. The driver points to the 400-second longest_qualifying_run (17:06:36–17:13:16, 22 fixes); but that span contains the 195 unmeasured seconds, and calling it a continuous dwell asserts the very continuity the trace cannot show. The rider points to the two admitted in-geofence runs (60 s and 145 s) and a 35-second shortfall against 180 s; but to make 145 s the ceiling the rider must treat the gap as no dwell, and the trace cannot show the driver left and re-entered either — the fixes bracketing the gap are 0.0 km apart, so the excursion is unmeasurable. POL-NS-06(i), the only route that would let the two intervals be summed, is unavailable: no traffic_advisory is present (EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0). So limb (c) is undecided over the stretch the defect covers. It is not satisfied, so the fee cannot stand and POL-NS-07 cannot fix the SGD 3.60 payout; and it is not failed, so POL-NS-06 cannot refund the SGD 4.50. The in-geofence dwell — the deciding fact — rests on this single impaired trace. Nothing independent carries it: the chat log has 0 messages, and the trip record and fare ledger carry the arrived event, the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination and the clean SGD 4.50 line, but not the dwell. POL-NS-08's closing sentence and POL-NS-09(e) therefore escalate the case, and the confidence is capped at the trace's 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, which engages POL-NS-09(a) as well. Accepted on the record: the arrived event (limb a) and the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination with no boarding (limb d), both on the clean trip record; the qualifying in-radius fixes (limb b); POL-NS-05 is not engaged, because the arrival marker was not false — the driver was at the pin and stationary at 17:06:36; the empty chat log means POL-NS-04 cannot run, and the absent rider track leaves rider presence undecidable under POL-NS-11 rather than exonerating the rider; and the fare ledger's SGD 4.50 line reconciles with the fee in force and discloses no POL-NS-08(d) defect. Open question for the reviewer: across the 195-second gap, was the driver continuously inside the 50 m radius (a mere sampling gap), or did he leave and return (a departure)? If the dwell is continuous, POL-NS-01 holds, the charge stands and POL-NS-07 pays the driver SGD 3.60. If it is broken, the dwell is 145 s, 35 s short of the 180 s minimum, and POL-NS-06 refunds the rider the SGD 4.50.

The escalation packet carries both advocate briefs, the pre-pass report, the clauses relied on (POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-06, POL-NS-07, POL-NS-08, POL-NS-09, POL-NS-11, POL-GEN-02) and this reasoning. POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, expressly not from the 'arrived' event, and the arrival marker here is BUTTON (driver-pressed), so POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed treatment does not apply and the trip record's wait_time_min of 6.7 minutes cannot supply it. Outside the hole the admitted readings show a longest continuous in-geofence run of 145 seconds (17:10:51-17:13:16), with a 60-second run before the hole; the derived 400-second 'longest_qualifying_run' spans the hole and so cannot show continuity across it. The rider's points that the period is 180 s and not 300, that dwell must be read on the GPS clock rather than the 17:06:36 arrival tap (arrival_marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not apply), and that the 400-second figure cannot bridge the hole are accepted — but the 35-second shortfall and the consequent full refund under POL-NS-06 rest on the same impaired trace and are not affirmatively established, so no refund issues.     • The 400-second longest_qualifying_run cannot be used to close that shortfall in the driver's favour. It runs from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16 and straddles the 195-second sampling hole from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51, during which the trace records no fix at all; those 195 seconds are unmeasured, not waited, which is precisely the situation POL-NS-08(b) treats as a policy-level defect when the gap inside the waiting window exceeds 120 seconds. Read as a continuous dwell the figure asserts the very continuity the trace cannot show, and it counts a hole as presence. (Trace impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.) kept
    • The two in-geofence intervals cannot be added together to manufacture 180 seconds. POL-NS-06(i) permits accumulation only where a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and the waiting window, such that holding position was not lawfully possible; EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory covers Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres in this window — so limb (i) is unavailable and the 60-second and 145-second intervals may not be summed, leaving the longest continuous stretch at 145 seconds. I cite the absent advisory for its absence, not for any content it does not have. (The GPS trace is impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.) discarded
    • POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: all four limbs must hold or the fee is not chargeable at all. Three of them are on the record — an arrived event, qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius under POL-NS-02, and a driver termination recorded as RIDER_NO_SHOW — but limb (c) fails, because a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force was not held. A no-show fee cannot be built on the one limb the evidence does not carry, and where a limb fails the refund is fixed by POL-NS-06. (The GPS trace cited is impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.) kept
    • The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line and nothing else. EV-FARE-02732 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole contested SGD 4.50 is still live and falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06; that clause allows no driver compensation where the dwell falls short, so the refund is not netted against any driver payment and no booking or platform fee arises on a trip that never ran. kept
    • In the alternative, if the Judge concludes that the effective dwell cannot be measured at all, the correct outcome is still not to leave the SGD 4.50 collected. POL-NS-08's closing sentence provides that where the only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under its limbs (a) to (d) the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09; the 195-second gap engages limb (b), and the trace's schema weight of 0.39 sits far below the 0.70 confidence floor of POL-NS-09(a). Escalation is terminal and the disputed fee is held rather than collected, so on either route — refund or escalation — the rider does not end up bearing a charge that the driver's own trace cannot support. discarded
  • DRIVER
    • The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-09-03 17:06:36 at Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres, zone class STANDARD, so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the platform's own record. kept
    • The driver's own trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m from the first qualifying fix at 17:06:36, with min_distance_m 0.157 m and 22 qualifying in-radius fixes — far more than the 3 consecutive fixes POL-NS-02 demands — so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied. This trace is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and I rely on it with that discount disclosed. kept
    • The derived arrival block puts the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run at 400 seconds, from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16, well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180), so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is met and the driver's own statement that he waited the full time is borne out by the telemetry. The underlying trace is impaired — weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE — and I disclose that. kept
    • The 195-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 is a sampling gap, not a departure: the fixes bracketing it are 0.0 km apart in a straight line, so the trace shows the driver held the same point while the sampler was silent. That gap is exactly the GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW impairment on EV-GPS-02732 (weight 0.39) which I have disclosed, and it does not contradict the continuous in-geofence dwell. kept
    • The dwell does not rest on the impaired trace alone: the trip record independently bounds the wait from the 17:06:36 arrival event to the 17:13:20 driver termination, a 404-second interval with no boarding event recorded. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the deciding fact is therefore carried by two independent artifacts, and the confidence cap is the maximum of their weights — the trip record's 1.0 — not the trace's 0.39. discarded
    • The trip record shows the trip terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 17:13:20, at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, and records no boarding event — limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on one of the three reason codes the clause recognises. kept
    • The arrival marker was not false: the first qualifying run records 7 in-geofence fixes across the 60 seconds from 17:06:36 with the driver stationary at the pin, so at the marker he was neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or more, and POL-NS-05 is not engaged. The trace carrying this is impaired (weight 0.39; GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE) and I disclose it. kept
    • The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 cannot run at all: the chat log for this trip carries 0 messages and the trip record records no in-app calls, so limb (a) — a locating or coordinating message sent by the rider during the waiting window — is not met, and the silence interval limb (b) turns on never arises. kept
    • The trace carries no rider track at all — rider_fix_count 0, rider_presence.available false — so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is undecidable rather than failed, and under POL-NS-11 that undecidability cannot exonerate the rider; nor does the absent rider track impair the driver's own arrival and dwell evidence for POL-NS-01. discarded
    • POL-NS-06's shortfall trigger does not engage: it fires only where the effective in-geofence dwell falls below the 180-second minimum, and on the primary arrival measure the dwell is 400 seconds. The separate accumulated-dwell block is the POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation tool and is unavailable on these facts, but the driver does not need it and does not assert it. discarded
    • The fare ledger is clean and shows no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect: its cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 reconciles exactly with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00 — so the fee the driver is asked to defend is the correct net figure. kept
    • With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee — SGD 3.60 — and the anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, and 1 of 81 completed trips is far below the 0.08 ratio. kept
    • The outcome this record produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION: where compensation is paid the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd, and the rider's charge simply stands as the disposition of the fee under POL-NS-07. Reading POL-NS-07's 'the ruling on the fee is NO_ACTION' as the ruling value would be a misreading of POL-GEN-03. kept

The decision

POL-GEN-06(4) names exactly four decisions:

nothing to adopt: the panel's best-supported proposal is ESCALATE.

Adopt the panel's proposal. The command carries the proposal's own ruling and amount, and the clauses the packet relied on.




Name the record-type items required, and when the window opens. The reviewer opens one window for both parties at once.

part 26: the evidence window is ops/evidence_window.py, which opens one window to both parties at once; the command below names the store it writes to, and that store is not tracked.

(at least 20 characters, citing one evidence id of this case and one clause id of the policy)

This form closes nothing by itself: there is no server. It checks the reason and builds the command; recording the decision is a command a person runs.
